gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have progressive, refractory, or recurrent HGG (WHO Grade III or IV).

gbm_population_flag.reason: 'HGG (WHO Grade III or IV)' without IDH requirement: grade IV glioma could be read as historical glioblastoma (D27C), which would make this mixed_glioma_gbm_named

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase 1, multicenter, open-label, dose escalation study of intravenous Berubicin in pediatric patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have progressive, refractory, or recurrent HGG (WHO Grade III or IV).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: The purpose of this first-in-pediatrics study is to examine the safety, tolerability, and PK of Berubicin

role_evidence.quote: To estimate the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and/or the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of single-agent Berubicin administered after at least 1 prior line of therapy in pediatric patients with progressive, refractory, or recurrent HGG.

coder_notes: Paediatric trial: inclusion requires age >=2 to <18 years, although registry stdAges lists CHILD and ADULT (S4 is coded by script; the population is effectively paediatric only). Glioblastoma is never named; only 'HGG (WHO Grade III or IV)'. cns5_terminology historical because of WHO grade III/IV glioma without IDH reference. PK is planned but the sample type is not stated (population PK model), so tumour_pk_planned unclear.
